android.desc:
Turn every new word into one you won’t forget.

Whether you're learning a new language, reading a book, or watching a movie — Wordwise helps you save and master the words that matter most to you.

Instead of memorizing random word lists, Wordwise lets you build your own vocabulary with words you actually encounter. Translate new words instantly, organize them with emojis and tags, and practice them through flashcards tailored to your learning.

Great for learners who:
🎓 Want to track new words from language classes
📚 Pick up vocabulary while reading, watching shows, or traveling
🧩 Prefer creating a personalized word list over generic ones
🎨 Like learning visually with emojis, tags, and color coding

Key Features:
🔍 Instant offline translations in 50+ languages
✍️ Add notes, emojis, tags, and examples to each word
🗂️ Browse and organize words in your own custom dictionary
🧠 Practice using flashcards with spaced repetition
📈 Track your learning progress and stats over time

Ready to take control of your vocabulary? Start building your personal word bank today with Wordwise!

Attributions:
- Some icons made by Freepik, Pixel Perfect, and Good Ware from Flaticon
- Animations provided by LottieFiles
- Translation functionality powered by Google ML Kit

show_hn.title: Show HN: I built a local-first language app to track and retain words

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

While learning Danish, I kept translating the same words over and over. I’d take notes, highlight books, save things in random places… then lose track of it all.

I wanted something simple. Translate a word, save it with context, and review it later so it actually sticks. Nothing I found really did that.

So I built my own app.

It lets you:

- Translate and save words instantly

- Add notes, tags, example sentences, gender, even emojis

- Review everything with flashcards using spaced repetition

- Track how many words you’ve really learned

- Use it fully offline with on-device ML Kit translation

I made it for myself, but once I showed it to others, people started asking to use it.

More details here: https://getwordwise.app

The app is live on the Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.andr.wordwise&pcampaignid=web_share

Would love your feedback. iOS is on the way if there's enough interest.
